notes: Solar dark photon helioscope search using Hinode X-Ray Telescope calibration darks and a solar eclipse image. This is a production-based (helioscope) constraint, NOT a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies. Coupling is kinetic mixing epsilon vs dark photon mass. Data points are approximate values read from figure 5/8 exclusion curves (darks optimistic + eclipse for low mass), supplemented by benchmark values in text (m=15 eV, eps=1.2e-10; m=400 eV, eps=6.1e-11; m=200 eV eps~2e-11 near limit; m=1 eV sensitivity ~1e-9). The resonant bump structure spans ~5-300 eV. Values are approximate; the actual limit curve is complex. Table 1 gives sensitivity to eps at m=1 eV: darks ~1e-9, eclipse ~4e-8. | selector: text (sole candidate)
